field_principles.field_principles: every Exp5766 field carries its audit rationale so the interaction audit is schema-stable.
field_principles.status: bare status lets downstream gates distinguish complete from blocked without parsing prose.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: structured gates fail closed before attribution on registry, traces, hashes, live reachability, resources, budgets, and provenance.
field_principles.spec_refs: REQ/SCENARIO anchors make the LOO attribution traceable to OpenSpec.
field_principles.upstream_artifact_hashes: Exp5753, Exp5727, component sources, and registry inputs are content-addressed before use.
field_principles.registry_precheck: confirms all public games and known levels are already complete, so no public solve target is admissible.
field_principles.registry_hash: ties the audit to the exact saturated registry bytes checked before scoring.
field_principles.public_game_count: fixed denominator for the 25 public leave-one-game-out folds.
field_principles.registry_level_count: fixed saturated known-level denominator; context only, never credit.
field_principles.component_inventory: freezes only existing reachable E3/StepwiseExplorer components before effect selection.
field_principles.component_source_hashes: source hashes prevent silent component drift between attribution and reuse.
field_principles.live_reachability_receipts: each audited component is tied to an existing live-policy hook rather than an orphan solver.
field_principles.loo_fold_manifest: one held-out game per fold with the 24-game development side visible.
field_principles.fold_disjointness_receipts: thresholds and selections are learned on development games and evaluated once on held-out games.
field_principles.paired_trial_manifest: baseline, deletion, and pairwise arms share observations, seeds, resets, budgets, caches, and stopping rules.
field_principles.exact_replay_receipts: trace hashes prove attribution used exact agent-owned live transitions, not source or offline BFS.
field_principles.positive_control_receipt: nondegenerate controls prove the harness can detect an effect before causal/null interpretation.
field_principles.negative_leak_canary_receipts: source and game-identity canaries are detected and rejected, not admitted as features.
field_principles.per_game_metrics: held-out rows expose proxy reproduction, validity, prediction, repeat, coverage, planning, budget, crash, step, and timing diagnostics.
field_principles.marginal_effects: single-component deletion/addition deltas are separated from pairwise interactions.
field_principles.pairwise_interaction_effects: interaction effect equals paired pair delta minus marginal terms and carries causal-call guards.
field_principles.confidence_intervals: paired uncertainty is reported for macro, marginal, and interaction deltas.
field_principles.development_selected_composition: the best game-blind composition is selected only on each fold's development side.
field_principles.composition_runtime_features: empty or game-blind feature list proves game identity is not a runtime input.
field_principles.loo_generalization_delta: held-out macro delta of the development-selected composition on the preregistered live-path utility.
field_principles.loo_generalization_delta_lcb: paired 95% lower bound for the held-out LOO generalization delta.
field_principles.causal_interaction_count: bare downstream gate scalar counts only interactions passing exact replay, controls, leak, fold, and sign guards.
field_principles.source_leak_count: bare downstream gate scalar; admitted source leaks must remain zero.
field_principles.game_identity_leak_count: bare downstream gate scalar; admitted game-identity leaks must remain zero.
field_principles.producer_gate_fields: lists the bare scalar downstream gates without wrapping their values in objects.
field_principles.solve_provenance: development_proxy -- known public live-trace attribution, not hidden-game self-discovery credit.
field_principles.arc_registry_delta: zero prevents attribution diagnostics from inflating the public solve registry.
field_principles.arc_solve_credited: false keeps known-level reproduction diagnostics out of solve credit.
field_principles.outer_loop_re_used: false excludes hand reverse engineering and offline ground-truth search.
field_principles.per_game_adapter_used: false excludes hand GameAdapter routes from attribution.
field_principles.source_read_used: false excludes game source from the component effect estimate.
field_principles.production_default_enabled: false keeps the selected composition out of submitted defaults.
field_principles.inference_substrate: agent-owned ARC live-trace replay without LLM, source, adapter, or policy-default mutation.
field_principles.random_seeds: matched trace replay and fold selection are deterministic.
field_principles.duration_s: wall time of the attribution audit is recorded for reproducibility.
field_principles.test_commands: records verification commands used for the artifact.
field_principles.test_exit_codes: records command exit codes rather than prose-only verification.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: content-addressed artifact catches silent metric, fold, or threshold drift.
field_principles.honest_verdict: terminal complete:/blocked: verdict reports a valid audit or the exact precondition blocker.
